verdict.rationale: The evidence shows general building blocks: GitHub Actions automates repository workflows and CI/CD, Copilot can review code, and push protection blocks pushes that contain secrets. None of it documents a way to *require* an approval gate before production. missing for 10: branch protection or required pull-request reviews, required status checks, deployment environment protection rules or required reviewers for production, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of enforced approval gates.
